one_line: This ad demonstrates the Refina AI app, showing how users can preview cosmetic procedures on their own faces to make informed decisions at home.

hook.what_happens: A woman performs the 'mirror test' by pulling her facial skin back in front of a bathroom mirror.
hook.why_it_works: It targets a highly relatable, universal behavior among people considering cosmetic procedures.

transcript.text: First, you stop guessing. The picture in your head was never accurate.
It was hope on a good day, and dread on a bad one.
Second, you find out what you don't want. Ruling a procedure out is an answer too.
And third, you decide before anyone is selling to you.
At home. On your own time. Not across a desk from someone with a price list and a waiting room.
Refina is a preview, not a promise. Your surgeon determines your result.
But you should get to see before you spend another year imagining it.

narrative_arc: Identify the common habit of manually pulling back skin to imagine cosmetic results.
Introduce Refina AI as a tool to replace guesswork with realistic previews.
Detail the three main benefits: stopping the guesswork, ruling out unwanted procedures, and deciding privately at home.
Address the limitation honestly (it is a preview, not a promise).
Call to action to download the app.

cta.what: Search Refina AI on the App Store.

subjects: Unidentified blonde woman, acting as the primary user demonstrating the app's utility on her own face.
what_makes_it_work: Relatable hook that mirrors real-life user behavior.
Clear, step-by-step app demonstration showing realistic results.
Strong emotional framing contrasting 'dread' and 'hope' with objective visualization.
Honest disclaimer ('a preview, not a promise') which builds consumer trust.

signature_moves: Elastic PopIn for UI elements and buttons
animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: UI elements and buttons pop in with elastic scaling, while menus and cards slide in from the edges.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements fade out or slide away to clear the screen for the next step.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Hard cuts separate major sections, while smooth wipes transition between comparison states.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The central portrait subjects remain largely static to emphasize the simulated changes.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Bursty and interactive, mimicking the feel of a responsive mobile application.

what_we_should_steal: The interactive SliderReveal for seamless before/after visualization.
DrawnCallout annotations to cleanly label specific visual details.
Staggered TagStack pops for presenting multiple options dynamically.
